tutorials.title: How to make this open-world game loading screen of your city using Claude
tutorials.trend: GTA 6 vychází dnes 19. 11. – všichni sdílí herní edity; vlastní generický loading screen, žádné logo ani mapa ze hry.
steps: Tell Claude your city and three spots you love.
Ask for a painted open-world loading screen with a progress bar and tips.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this magic wardrobe portal intro using Claude
tutorials.trend: Narnie od Grety Gerwig jde 26. 11. do IMAX a pak na Netflix; 'vstup do jiného světa' je ideální intro edit (jen inspirace, žádné postavy).
steps: Ask Claude for an old wooden wardrobe in a dark room.
Doors open, snow blows out, the camera flies into a winter forest.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this Advent calendar for your page using Claude
tutorials.trend: 1. 12. začíná advent – tvůrci a značky dělají 'otevři okénko' reels; chytáme to týden dopředu.
steps: Give Claude 24 small surprises: tips, links, jokes.
Ask for a cozy calendar where each door pops open with a glow.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this Thanksgiving countdown clock using Claude
tutorials.trend: Díkůvzdání 26. 11. a hned Black Friday – US publikum sdílí odpočty; animovaný flip-clock s pečeným krocanem a listím.
steps: Tell Claude the date and your vibe.
Ask for a warm flip-clock countdown with falling leaves.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this snow globe of your home town using Higgsfield
tutorials.trend: Vánoční 'snow globe' AI edity se každoročně šíří od poloviny listopadu na IG a TikToku; foto města → animovaná sněžítka.
steps: Upload a photo of your town.
Ask Higgsfield for a glass snow globe with your town inside.
Animate it: a hand shakes it and the snow swirls.
Higgsfield builds it, you tweak it.
